deck.audience: engineering managers and HR leaders benchmarking developer compensation and workforce trends

brief.title: Developer Workforce & Compensation Trends — 2024 Stack Overflow Survey
brief.one_liner: Key findings on employment patterns, salary by role and language, and workplace preferences from 65,000+ developers surveyed in 2024.
brief.goal: Equip engineering leaders with actionable benchmarks on developer salaries, experience-to-pay ratios, and shifting work-environment preferences to inform hiring and retention strategies.

slides.title: Developer Workforce & Compensation Trends — 2024 Stack Overflow Survey
slides.objective: Cover slide with deck title, subtitle '65,437 respondents across 180+ countries', and source attribution.

slides.title: 84% of Developers Are Working, but Full-Time Employment Dips in the U.S.
slides.objective: Show the global employment status breakdown (full-time 69%, freelance 16.4%, student 13.2%, etc.) and highlight the U.S. drop from 69% to 64.8%. Use a stacked or grouped bar chart comparing global vs. U.S. figures.

slides.title: In-Person Work Rises to 20% While Hybrid Holds Steady at 42%
slides.objective: Visualize the three-year trend of remote vs. hybrid vs. in-person work (2022–2024) using a simple bar or donut chart. Emphasize the steady climb of in-person from 15% to 20%.

slides.title: Senior Executives and Dev Advocates Top $124K+ Median Salary
slides.objective: Horizontal bar chart of median salary by developer type (top 10 roles). Include Senior Executive $127K, Dev Advocate $124K, Manager $116K, Dev Experience $109K, SRE $99K, Cloud Infra $97K, etc. Reference figure_1.jpg.

slides.title: Experience Pays: Top Roles Combine 14+ Years with Six-Figure Salaries
slides.objective: Scatter plot of median salary (y-axis) vs. average years of experience (x-axis) by developer type, sized or colored by number of responses. Highlight the cluster of senior roles in the upper-right and Student as an outlier at $15K. Reference figure_2.jpg.

slides.title: Erlang & Clojure Developers Earn >$95K; Dart & Prolog Below $45K
slides.objective: Scatter plot of median salary vs. average experience by programming language. Call out top earners (Erlang $97K, Clojure $95K, Elixir $93K) and lowest earners (Dart $44K, Prolog $43K, PHP $49K). Note the overall $10K drop in average salary range vs. 2023. Reference figure_3.jpg.

slides.title: 47% Work at Sub-100 Orgs; 62% Influence Tech Purchases
slides.objective: Split visual: left side shows company-size distribution (pie or bar), right side shows that 62% of developers influence tech purchases and 60% prefer a build-and-buy approach. Useful context for vendor-side audience.

slides.title: Takeaways: What These Trends Mean for Hiring & Retention
slides.objective: Bullet-point summary slide with 4–5 actionable insights: (1) full-time employment softening — plan for more contractors; (2) in-person mandates growing but hybrid still dominant; (3) DevRel and SRE roles command premium pay; (4) language choice correlates with pay — niche languages pay more; (5) most developers influence purchasing — engage them directly.
